observations.observation: The observed new-rider 30-day retention rate was 99.54% among 18701 eligible riders.
Riders exposed to a failure on their first attempt had a lower observed return rate (99.66%) compared to those who did not (99.54%).
Early exposure to any failed swap in the first 7 days was associated with a retention rate of 99.95%, differing from 99.43% for those without early failures.
CSAT scores were available for only 46.51% of riders, meaning absent CSAT cannot strictly be interpreted as negative feedback.
